race.comment: DIVINE EFFORT (5) raced on the speed and gave his all but went under in a photo over 2220m at Grafton last start. That was his first appearance in five weeks so expect him to strip fitter today. Great chance to go one better. BOW TIE AFFAIR (4) hasn't been all that far away in recent runs. Stepped up sharply to 2220m at Grafton last time where he boxed on well without threatening. Should take a lot from that hit-out and is likely to play a key role. OUR SPARKY (8) came from next to last on straightening to get up for third recently over 1630m at Grafton. On trial at this distance but it looks the right fit at this stage. SEALORD (2) broke his maiden status in convincing fashion last start at the Gold Coast over 2050m. Has plenty of upside so should be able to take this next step. FLAMING GENESIS (7) ran a cheeky race first-up over 1700m and will tighten right up for this assignment.
